title: stoa-imap: auth_failures not incremented when LOGINDISABLED rejects AUTHENTICATE
description: In session/mod.rs Event::CommandAuthenticateReceived, when !ctx.tls, auth_failures is incremented and should_disconnect is checked. But the code path for !ctx.tls calls server.authenticate_finish(no).ok() and then increments auth_failures. Looking at the code: yes it DOES increment auth_failures (line ctx.auth_failures += 1). This is correct — not a bug. Withdraw.
